fixtures.kind: oracle input (../oracle/I3b-scores/gen_cases.py, deterministic): 25 rank, 25 peak-level, 480 PScore (both overloads) and 200 AScore::compute cases over the five upstream DTA inputs

evidence_tier: 1 (executed differential against the Release build: 730 cases, including 160 site-scoring AScore::compute runs (40 with two or three sites) in Da and ppm and both PScore overloads), 2 (link probe for the correction-term defect), 3 (every PScore_test.cpp and AScore_test.cpp literal), 4 (native refusals and invariants)
openmp: No #pragma omp in PScore.cpp or AScore.cpp; the port is serial, as the source.
notes: PScore.cpp defines massCorrectionTerm, cleavageCorrectionTerm and modificationCorrectionTerm as free functions in namespace OpenMS, not as the PScore:: static members the header declares; the members have no definition and a call fails to link. The Rust associated functions carry the free functions' bodies.
The vector overload of PScore::computePScore uses p = level / mz_window, the single-spectrum overload p = (level + 1) / mz_window; both are kept.

AScore::computeCumulativeScore_ delegates to Math::binomial_cdf_complement (Boost incomplete beta upstream); the port uses concept::math_functions::binomial_cdf_complement, whose agreement with the source is recorded at that function.

oracle.runs: two invocations of run.sh on 2026-09-28, each running the driver twice in fresh processes with a clean environment; all four outputs byte-identical, exit 0, empty stderr
oracle.comparison: ranks, peak-level m/z, theoretical sizes, sequences and metadata keys exact; scores and metadata doubles to 1e-9 relative (Boost incomplete beta vs the port's log-domain binomial sum); the source PeptideHit's 'rank' meta value is compared with the Rust PeptideHit::rank field
oracle.link_probe: probe_correction.cpp calls PScore::massCorrectionTerm, cleavageCorrectionTerm and modificationCorrectionTerm; linking against the Release libOpenMS fails with three undefined references (results/probe_correction_link.log, sha256 7f39ec38b2d8734f12f8d1b59ec62f0329f5fdd4d0cf45da5edf450b7a593c70): tier 2 evidence for the missing-definition defect
